description_en: Add whitelist IP addresses for an Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 添加针对DDoS高防实例的白名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo add-auto-cc-whitelist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --whitelist src_:_192.XX.XX.1_,_src_:_192.XX.XX.2 --expire-time 0 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddAutoCcWhitelist

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance for which you want to add whitelist IP addresses.

> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances.
parameters.description_zh:
要添加白名单IP的DDoS高防实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID。
parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance for which you want to add whitelist IP addresses.

> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances
parameters.help_zh:
要添加白名单IP的DDoS高防实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The configuration of the whitelist IP addresses that you want to add. This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct of a whitelist IP address that contains the following parameter:

- **src**: String type | Required | The IP address that you want to add to the whitelist.
parameters.description_zh:
要添加的白名单IP的配置。使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组的每个元素是一个白名单IP结构体，具体包含以下参数：

- **src**：String类型 | 必选 | 要添加到白名单的IP地址。
